title: anim.winner/1
description: data/anim/winner.json: the winner in the wreckage after a KO (docs/animation/overhaul-plan.md, unit K). Render only, outside the sim's data hash. Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore. Cross-reference: every `end` key other than `default` is a shape key in data/anim/ragdoll_motion.json shapes (checked by tools/lib/xref-fight.js, winner-shape).

start.description: Seconds after the KO when the winner stops (win.stand).

survey.description: How long he looks over the scene (win.survey).

yaw.description: Radians the head sweeps each way during the survey.

end.description: Per shape key (the ragdoll shapes of ragdoll_motion.json), or `default`: whether he then holds the survey or takes emote.victory.
